lines.text: Luke had two liters of water on his back and couldn't drink a drop.
On the cold, windy ridge, the water sitting in his drink tube had frozen solid.
Here's the fix. After every sip, blow the water back into the bladder so the tube stays empty.
Tuck the tube under your jacket, close to your body,
and fill up with warm water, not hot.
Luke sipped all the way to the top.
Save this before your next cold hike.
